fn make(calls: int as ref): byte[] =>
  calls += 1
  return {77b, 97b, 110b}

fn main(): void =>
  var calls: int = 0
  println(make(calls).toHex())
  println(calls)
  println(make(calls).toBase64())
  println(calls)
  println(make(calls).toStringLatin1())
  println(calls)
  var captured: byte[] = {77b, 97b, 110b}
  var encode: fn(): str = fn(): str => captured.toBase64()
  println(encode())
